channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Syrian child killed after roadside object explodes near Damascus
item.description: A child has been killed after an explosive object detonated when he touched it near Damascus.

item.title: Ukrainian drone evades Russian helicopter fire to strike oil tanker
item.description: Ukraine has released footage showing a drone evading fire from a Russian helicopter before striking a Russian oil tanker

item.title: Six killed, 130 missing after Indonesian passenger ship capsizes
item.description: Six people have been killed and 130 remain missing after a passenger ship capsized in the Java Sea off Indonesia.

item.title: World leaders gather in New Delhi for final day of BRICS summit
item.description: BRICS leaders gathered in New Delhi for the final day of the summit amid divisions over the wars in Iran and Ukraine.

item.title: Red Sea nations watch as Houthis seize Bab al-Mandeb strait
item.description: Houthi control of Bab al-Mandeb chokes Suez Canal revenues, triggers refugee flows, and exposes regional security gaps.

item.title: More than 2,000 Yemenis flee to Djibouti amid Houthi advances
item.description: Escalating fighting along Yemen’s western coast has driven more than 2,000 Yemenis across the Red Sea to Djibouti.

item.title: Iran-GCC summit: What’s behind the meeting, why is Bahrain not attending?
item.description: Iran says it plans to hold talks with Iraq and Gulf nations in Oman to help strengthen shared regional security.

item.title: Ukraine drone strikes kill four as Russia attacks close to Poland border
item.description: Russia says four people killed in Ukrainian strikes as both sides continue to attack each other with waves of drones.

item.title: The Iran war reveals the limits of BRICS
item.description: The bloc struggles to translate its economic weight into geopolitical sway. But there may be a silver lining to it.

item.title: The Houthis’ escalation in Yemen could flop
item.description: The Houthis and Iran are seeking to gain leverage, but they may instead get a unified front in the Red Sea.
